City council approves new transit plan

By Jane O’Brien · October 30, 2026

The city council voted 7–2 on Tuesday to approve a $1.2 billion transit plan, ending months of debate.

“This is a generational investment,” said Mayor Ana Ruiz. Critics disagree, calling it "too expensive".

We can't afford to wait another decade.

Councilmember Park

What happens next

Construction begins in spring. Fares stay flat through 2028.

  • Three new bus lines
  • Two light-rail extensions
  • Free transfers
